BASE=pathlib.Path('/data/mini_linq-wt/baseline-1106/target/baseline-1106'); ROOT=BASE.parents[1]
sys.path.insert(0,str(ROOT/'tools'));from bench_check import Checker
TMP=pathlib.Path('/dev/shm/baseline-1106'); TMP.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('collect',ROOT/'experiments/gpu/compare/performance_cpu_collect.py'); c=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec);spec.loader.exec_module(c)
NAMES=c.NAMES+['tpch_q06','tpch_q19']
RECORD=BASE/('samples-tpch.json' if sys.argv[1]=='tpch' else 'samples.json'); records=json.loads(RECORD.read_text()) if RECORD.exists() else []
def save():RECORD.write_text(json.dumps(records,indent=2))
def sample(cmd,label,env=None):
    path=BASE/'samples'/f'{label}.json';path.parent.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    command=['flock','/tmp/mini_linq-timing-gate.lock','flock','-x','/tmp/mini_linq-timing.lock',sys.executable,str(BASE/'sample.py'),str(path),*map(str,cmd)]
    start=time.monotonic();p=subprocess.run(command,env=dict(os.environ,**(env or {})));r=json.loads(path.read_text());r['gate_seconds']=time.monotonic()-start;r['gate_command']=command
    if p.returncode: raise RuntimeError(r)
    return r
phase=sys.argv[1]
if phase=='prepare':
    c.CACHE=TMP;c.RAW=BASE/'current/raw';c.OUT=BASE/'current/metadata';c.prepare()
    import ast,inspect
    tree=ast.parse(inspect.getsource(c.prepare))
    class OriginalPath(ast.NodeTransformer):
     def visit_Constant(self,node):
      if node.value=='src/queries/retail/tpch':node.value='src/queries/tpch'
      return node
    exec(compile(ast.fix_missing_locations(OriginalPath().visit(tree)),str(c.__file__),'exec'),c.__dict__)
    c.NAMES=['tpch_q06','tpch_q19'];c.prepare()
elif phase=='tpch':
    for name in NAMES:
      for config in ['default','par']:
       for pair in range(5):
        for side in (['reference','current'] if pair%2==0 else ['current','reference']):
         label=f'tpch-{name}-{config}-{pair}-{side}'
         if any(r['id']==label for r in records):continue
         metrics=TMP/'metrics.json';answers=TMP/'answers.json'
         cmd=[BASE/side/'crates'/name/'timing-worker',TMP/'data'/name,config,'3',answers,metrics,BASE/'current/raw'/name/'oracle.json']
         r=sample(cmd,label,{'BENCH_CHECK_MODE':'full' if pair==0 else 'sampled','BENCH_CHECK_SEED':str(20261106+pair),'RAYON_NUM_THREADS':'24'})
         m=json.loads(metrics.read_text());c.validation_evidence(m,require_native=True)
         r.update(id=label,suite='tpch-'+config,kernel=name,config=config,pair=pair,side=side,value=m['median_ms'],metrics=m)
         records.append(r);save();answers.unlink();metrics.unlink();print(label,m['median_ms'],flush=True)
elif phase=='doop':
 with Checker(BASE/'current/doop-target/release/bench-check',seed=20261106) as checker:
  for variant in ['doop','field_flow']:
   witness=TMP/'witness.json'
   def command(side,engine):
    binaries=BASE/side/'doop-target/release'
    if variant=='doop':return [binaries/'doop-parallel','/data/doop-bench/doop-data/xalan','--engine',engine]
    return [binaries/('srd-doop-mini' if engine=='mini' else 'srd-doop-mini-par'),'/data/doop-bench/doop-vs-srdatalog-20261026/fresh-corpus/prepared/xalan',*(['--threads','24'] if engine=='mini-par' else [])]
   reference=sample(command('reference','ascent' if variant=='doop' else 'mini'),variant+'-oracle',{'BENCH_CHECK_MODE':'full','BENCH_CHECK_WITNESS':str(witness),'RAYON_NUM_THREADS':'24'})
   checker.register_witness(variant,witness);witness.unlink();reference.update(id=variant+'-oracle',purpose='oracle');records.append(reference);save()
   for engine in ['mini','mini-par']:
    for pair in range(5):
     for side in (['reference','current'] if pair%2==0 else ['current','reference']):
      key=f'{variant}-{engine}-{side}';label=f'{key}-{pair}';plan=checker.plan(key,variant,pair)
      r=sample(command(side,engine),label,dict(checker.env(plan),BENCH_CHECK_WITNESS=str(witness),RAYON_NUM_THREADS='24'))
      evidence=checker.check(key,variant,pair,witness);witness.unlink()
      value=(float(re.search(r'compute_seconds=([0-9.]+)',r['stdout']).group(1)) if variant=='doop' else json.loads(next(line.split('\t',1)[1] for line in r['stdout'].splitlines() if line.startswith('runtime\t')))['evaluation_seconds'])
      r.update(id=label,suite=variant,kernel=engine,config=engine,pair=pair,side=side,value=value,validation=evidence)
